probes.witness: Algeria attributed its abstention to concerns over implementation of resolution 2722 (2024) and what it regarded as misuse or misinterpretation of self-defence through attacks on sovereign countries’ territory.
probes.assertion: Algeria abstained over implementation of resolution 2722 (2024) and perceived misuse or misinterpretation of self-defence in attacks on sovereign countries’ territory.

probes.assertion: Algeria said its abstention was prompted by attacks on Algeria’s own territory.
